name: Sheikh Ladies & Gents Tailors
tagline: Ladies and gents tailoring for every occasion in Aminabad, Lucknow
about: We have been stitching for 22 years, and my father started this shop. We stitch blouses, salwar suits, kurtas, lehenga and sherwani, and we do all kinds of alterations. Chikankari work kurtas are also available on order. For wedding orders we give a fitting trial before the final stitching.
hours: Open 11am to 9pm. Friday is a half day. Normal orders ready in 5-7 days, urgent orders in 2 days with extra charge.

products.name: Home measurement visit
products.description: For ladies within Lucknow, on appointment
